scope: Static nonrelativistic fixed-nuclei finite-basis Coulomb many-electron eigenstate
existing_WorldSpec: Unchanged. physics.RHF explicitly labels the reference calculation only; correlation_model.FCI separately labels the returned wavefunction. GROUNDED legacy engine mode is not material validation.
physical_object: Neutral singlet hydrogen assemblies, 2/4/6 atoms, STO-3G, all electrons and all orbitals, at most 400 determinants; actual authorized first object H4 only
new_freedom: Determinant-superposition amplitudes and two-particle RDMs, not a two-state effective ket

parameter_provenance.nuclei_geometry: AI selected external control in angstrom, not measurement
parameter_provenance.charges_masses: Electronic nuclear charges from specified elements; no nuclear dynamics/masses used
parameter_provenance.h1_eri: PySCF 2.8.0 Gaussian integrals of actual electronic Coulomb Hamiltonian, Eh
parameter_provenance.basis: STO-3G library basis assumption, not basis-converged material physics
parameter_provenance.reference_MOs: Computed RHF full orbital span, not truncated active space
parameter_provenance.FCI: Mature direct_spin0 singlet solver; complete determinant space only within this basis
parameter_provenance.Lowdin_partition: Symmetric orthonormalization of AO overlap, one H1s function/site. Declared nonunique analysis convention
parameter_provenance.numerical_settings: Frozen algorithmic tolerances, not fitted physical parameters

bridge.input: Existing WorldSpec plus explicit frozen correlation envelope
bridge.output: FCI coefficients in exported alpha/beta bitstring order, RHF MO coefficients, overlap, integrals, spin RDMs
bridge.units: Energy Eh, positions angstrom, local occupations dimensionless, spin correlations hbar^2
bridge.MO_to_Lowdin: U = S^(1/2) C; real full orthogonal square transformation
bridge.losses: No continuum/relativity/basis convergence/nuclear motion/bath; finite basis is not exact molecule
bridge.complex_state: Not admitted; present real Coulomb eigenstates only

forecast_not_quality: Correlation energy <-0.001 Eh and nonidempotency >0.05 are falsifiable forecasts. Numerically valid failure is scientific negative evidence, not execution failure.
observables: Natural occupations; spin-summed nonidempotency; site populations, opposite-spin double occupancy, charge covariance, isotropic singlet spin correlations versus RHF Wick baseline
not_observed: No dynamics, forces, energy conversion, bulk phase, Mott transition, experimental lifetime, entropy or useful energy density
runtime: Parent never imports a solver; independent OS child, no RLIMIT_DATA/AS, outer cgroup remains 1CPU/1GiB/0extraSwap/networknone. Native failure preserves intent, parent state and raw files; no retry.
second_stage: NOT_SELECTED_OR_PREAUTHORIZED. If fresh matching Human grant includes it, Work AI first reads actual state/quality, then freezes one existing DISPLACE_ATOM z-vector norm <=0.05angstrom or STOP. Source SHA, observation SHA, action SHA, first run id, prediction and falsifier required.
external_status: NOT_PUBLISHED_NOT_EXECUTED; runtime resource limits and real engine compatibility pending actual Runner
